findings.description: The Requirement (line 4274) and Rationale (4278) assert an exhaustive enumeration of '다섯 개의 fit 트리거 지점'. There is a sixth submitTerminalFit call site: requestViewportSync (frontend/src/components/Terminal/TerminalView.tsx:1146-1181) calls submitTerminalFit at :1164 only under `fitFirst && isRenderable`, where isRenderable is the same isVisibleRef + offsetWidth>0 + offsetHeight>0 predicate the other sites use. On the !isRenderable path it falls through to scrollToBottom() and returns with no fit, no fit_skipped_non_renderable event and no retry (its `attempts < 2` retry is reachable only from the submitTerminalFit rejection callback and the catch block, not from the non-renderable branch). It is therefore the only 0-size fit-skip site in the file with zero observability, and the Implementation Notes instruction to gather '0-size skip 을 단일 재시도 스케줄러로' would miss it. Mitigating fact: requestViewportSync never writes geometryReadyRef (its callers are handleFontSizeChange:1229, snapshot restore:2335, replay-write:2517), so its skip does not by itself leave the ready barrier unresolved — the harm is a false exhaustiveness claim in normative text, not an uncovered barrier path.

Internal numeric contradiction newly created by the iter-6 fix. Implementation Notes (line 4314) still reads '네 지점이 각자 재시도 타이머를 갖게 하지 말고…' while the Requirement (4274) and Rationale (4278) now say five. The iter-6 Change Note itself scopes the fix to 'the Requirement, Trace Links and new AC-7' and never touched Implementation Notes, so the block now carries two different site counts (and, per VP7-F1, the true count is six). An implementer reading the consolidation instruction would build a scheduler for four sites.

AC-8 boundary control (b) enumerates the server-mode acceptance conditions as 'suspendedBrowserDriver 의 clientId/viewGeneration/leaseGeneration 일치' only. The code's serverAuthorityUserMutation conjunction (SessionManager.ts:2996-3002) additionally requires runtime.driver.active === 'server-headless', runtime.responder.active === 'server-headless' and runtime.responder.serverEnabled. A test built literally to AC-8(b) in server mode would observe rejection, not acceptance. This cannot produce a false green (the AC demands acceptance be confirmed, so the control fails loudly), but the enumeration is incomplete and will cost a debugging cycle. The legacy-mode enumeration in the same sentence is complete and correct.

AC-4 (as raised in iter 6) now mandates, for disposition A, 'Ctrl+B keydown 을 받아 prefix 모드로 진입시키는 핸들러' in frontend/src, without any statement about its interaction with terminal keystroke passthrough. Ctrl+B is a live terminal key (readline backward-char, vim page-up) and both tests fire pressCtrlB while the xterm surface is focused after waitForTerminal. Adding a global prefix handler therefore risks swallowing a keystroke that FR-BGSTAB-017 / REL-BGSTAB-016 govern. Not a blocker — disposition C remains available per AC-1 and the Implementation Notes already flag that cause-1 disposition A is a policy decision — but the requirement does not name the passthrough constraint that a disposition-A implementer must respect.
